description: React component for selecting a team with async loading, search, and custom styling, used in the Mattermost admin console for filtering system users by team.

methods.name: loadListInPageNumber
methods.description: Loads a page of teams from the server and updates the options list.

methods.name: searchInList
methods.description: Searches for teams matching a search term via server API.

methods.name: handleMenuScrolledToBottom
methods.description: Loads more teams when the user scrolls to the bottom of the menu.

methods.name: handleOnChange
methods.description: Handles selection change, updates state and calls parent callback.
